sec1_b_eff_from_3p4sigma.note: b_eff = (background density at the event)/(signal density at the event per unit s) in the LZ unbinned likelihood; b_eff = b_box/eps_box where eps_box is the fraction of the signal PDF inside the box.  The paper's spectra spread signal over S1c ~100-600 phd, so eps_box < 1.
